rationale: Oracle's official Field Service page explicitly says the product combines automation and embedded AI, forecasts demand using AI-driven models, and embeds AI across field service capabilities at no extra charge. This is explicit product AI, not a separate add-on. The product's scheduling, dispatch, routing, job and inventory workflows remain useful without AI, supporting AI-enabled.
ai_type_rationale: Field service management has substantial conventional scheduling/dispatching, technician management, parts and workflow functions; embedded predictive AI enhances rather than constitutes the full core.
version_scope: No release/version in source record. Official page describes Oracle Field Service current functionality; no historical version can be tied to record, but product identity and no-extra-charge applicability are explicit.
issues: Historical version/date not supplied; current page is the available product-specific evidence.

sources.excerpt: Oracle Field Service combines automation and embedded AI to help plan, schedule, and execute field work... Forecast demand with confidence ... AI-driven models ... AI at no extra cost. Oracle embeds AI across field service capabilities at no additional charge.
sources.applicability: Official Oracle page explicitly identifies Oracle Field Service and says AI is embedded at no extra cost, addressing feature inclusion; record's product functionality matches field service management.
